str(ln_gagal)

```{r}
# ==== Library ====
library(readxl)
library(mixtools)
library(ggplot2)

# ==== 1. Baca Data ====
file_path <- "C:/Users/Surya/ACASE/Raw Data ACS.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "yallah")

# ==== 2. Ambil variabel & Bersihkan ====
curah <- as.numeric(df$`Rataan Curah Hujan`)
produktivitas <- as.numeric(df$`Rataan Produktivitas Lahan`)

curah_clean <- curah[!is.na(curah) & is.finite(curah)]
produktivitas_clean <- produktivitas[!is.na(produktivitas) & is.finite(produktivitas)]

# ==== 3. Fit Gaussian Mixture (Curah) ====
set.seed(123)
fit_curah <- normalmixEM(curah_clean, k = 2, maxit = 1000)
summary(fit_curah)

# Plot distribusi Curah
df_curah <- data.frame(x = curah_clean)
ggplot(df_curah, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) fit_curah$lambda[1] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_curah$mu[1], sd = fit_curah$sigma[1]),
                color = "red", size = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) fit_curah$lambda[2] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_curah$mu[2], sd = fit_curah$sigma[2]),
                color = "blue", size = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x)
    fit_curah$lambda[1] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_curah$mu[1], sd = fit_curah$sigma[1]) +
    fit_curah$lambda[2] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_curah$mu[2], sd = fit_curah$sigma[2]),
    color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gaussian Mixture (2 Komponen) - Curah Hujan",
       x = "Curah Hujan", y = "Density")

# ==== 4. Fit Gaussian Mixture (Produktivitas) ====
set.seed(123)
fit_prod <- normalmixEM(produktivitas_clean, k = 2, maxit = 1000)
summary(fit_prod)

# Plot distribusi Produktivitas
df_prod <- data.frame(x = produktivitas_clean)
ggplot(df_prod, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "lightgreen", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) fit_prod$lambda[1] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_prod$mu[1], sd = fit_prod$sigma[1]),
                color = "red", size = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) fit_prod$lambda[2] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_prod$mu[2], sd = fit_prod$sigma[2]),
                color = "blue", size = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = function(x)
    fit_prod$lambda[1] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_prod$mu[1], sd = fit_prod$sigma[1]) +
    fit_prod$lambda[2] * dnorm(x, mean = fit_prod$mu[2], sd = fit_prod$sigma[2]),
    color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gaussian Mixture (2 Komponen) - Produktivitas",
       x = "Produktivitas Lahan", y = "Density")


```

```{r}
# Bersihkan data curah
curah_clean <- curah[!is.na(curah) & is.finite(curah)]

# --- Model normal tunggal (k=1) ---
mu1 <- mean(curah_clean)
sd1 <- sd(curah_clean)
loglik1 <- sum(dnorm(curah_clean, mean=mu1, sd=sd1, log=TRUE))

n <- length(curah_clean)
k1_params <- 2
AIC1 <- -2*loglik1 + 2*k1_params
BIC1 <- -2*loglik1 + log(n)*k1_params

# --- Model mixture normal (k=2) ---
set.seed(123)
fit2 <- normalmixEM(curah_clean, k=2, maxit=1000)

k2_params <- (3*2 - 1)
loglik2 <- fit2$loglik
AIC2 <- -2*loglik2 + 2*k2_params
BIC2 <- -2*loglik2 + log(n)*k2_params

# --- Hasil perbandingan ---
results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Normal tunggal (k=1)", "Gaussian Mixture (k=2)"),
  LogLik = c(loglik1, loglik2),
  AIC = c(AIC1, AIC2),
  BIC = c(BIC1, BIC2)
)

print(results)

# --- Plot perbandingan ---
hist(curah_clean, breaks=30, freq=FALSE, col="lightblue",
     main="Histogram Curah Hujan + Fit Distribusi")

# Normal tunggal
curve(dnorm(x, mean=mu1, sd=sd1), add=TRUE, col="red", lwd=2)

# Mixture k=2
curve(fit2$lambda[1]*dnorm(x, fit2$mu[1], fit2$sigma[1]) +
      fit2$lambda[2]*dnorm(x, fit2$mu[2], fit2$sigma[2]),
      add=TRUE, col="darkgreen", lwd=2, lty=2)

```

```{r}
# ===========================
# PRODUKTIVITAS
# ===========================

# Bersihkan data produktivitas
produktivitas_clean <- produktivitas[!is.na(produktivitas) & is.finite(produktivitas)]

# --- Model normal tunggal (k=1) ---
mu_p1 <- mean(produktivitas_clean)
sd_p1 <- sd(produktivitas_clean)
loglik_p1 <- sum(dnorm(produktivitas_clean, mean=mu_p1, sd=sd_p1, log=TRUE))

n_p <- length(produktivitas_clean)
k1_params_p <- 2
AIC_p1 <- -2*loglik_p1 + 2*k1_params_p
BIC_p1 <- -2*loglik_p1 + log(n_p)*k1_params_p

# --- Model mixture normal (k=2) ---
set.seed(123)
fit2_p <- normalmixEM(produktivitas_clean, k=2, maxit=1000)

k2_params_p <- (3*2 - 1)
loglik_p2 <- fit2_p$loglik
AIC_p2 <- -2*loglik_p2 + 2*k2_params_p
BIC_p2 <- -2*loglik_p2 + log(n_p)*k2_params_p

# --- Hasil perbandingan ---
results_p <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Normal tunggal (k=1)", "Gaussian Mixture (k=2)"),
  LogLik = c(loglik_p1, loglik_p2),
  AIC = c(AIC_p1, AIC_p2),
  BIC = c(BIC_p1, BIC_p2)
)

print(results_p)

# --- Plot perbandingan ---
hist(produktivitas_clean, breaks=30, freq=FALSE, col="lightgreen",
     main="Histogram Produktivitas Lahan + Fit Distribusi")

# Normal tunggal
curve(dnorm(x, mean=mu_p1, sd=sd_p1), add=TRUE, col="red", lwd=2)

# Mixture k=2
curve(fit2_p$lambda[1]*dnorm(x, fit2_p$mu[1], fit2_p$sigma[1]) +
      fit2_p$lambda[2]*dnorm(x, fit2_p$mu[2], fit2_p$sigma[2]),
      add=TRUE, col="darkgreen", lwd=2, lty=2)

```


```{r}
# ===============================

# Load library
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ==== 1. Baca file Excel ====
file_path <- "C:/Users/Surya/ACASE/Raw Data ACS.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "tolong")

# ==== 2. Bersihkan nama kolom ====
df <- janitor::clean_names(df)

# Cek kolom yang ada
colnames(df)

# ==== 3. Ringkasan statistik deskriptif ====

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#Pastikan variabel terbaca benar
df <- df %>%
  rename(
    gagal_ln = `s_ln_gagal`,
    produktivitas = `rataan_produktivitas_lahan`,
    curah = `rataan_curah_hujan`,
    cluster = `kelompok_risiko`
  ) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

colnames(df)
# ==== BOX PLOT dengan sumbu sama ====


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Fungsi untuk hitung R^2
get_r2 <- function(x, y) {
  mod <- lm(y ~ x)
  summary(mod)$r.squared
}

# ==== Scatter plot Curah vs Gagal LN ====
r2_curah_gagal <- get_r2(df$curah, df$gagal_ln)

ggplot(df, aes(x = curah, y = gagal_ln, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Scatter Curah Hujan vs Tingkat Gagal Panen (R² = ", round(r2_curah_gagal, 3), ")"),
    x = "Curah Hujan", y = "S Ln Gagal Panen"
  )

# ==== Scatter plot Produktivitas vs Gagal LN ====
r2_prod_gagal <- get_r2(df$produktivitas, df$gagal_ln)

ggplot(df, aes(x = produktivitas, y = gagal_ln, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Scatter Produktivitas vs Tingkat Gagal Panen (R² = ", round(r2_prod_gagal, 3), ")"),
    x = "Produktivitas", y = "Tingkat Gagal Panen"
  )

# ==== Scatter plot Produktivitas vs Curah ====
r2_prod_curah <- get_r2(df$produktivitas, df$curah)

ggplot(df, aes(x = produktivitas, y = curah, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Scatter Produktivitas vs Curah Hujan (R² = ", round(r2_prod_curah, 3), ")"),
    x = "Produktivitas", y = "Curah Hujan"
  )

```
